# service-endpoints commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `get` | Get details for a specific service endpoint |
| `list` | List registered service endpoints in the environment |
| `register` | Register a service endpoint: webhook, queue, topic, eventhub |
| `unregister` | Unregister a service endpoint from Dataverse |
| `update` | Update an existing service endpoint |
